subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2443
title: Requires a county clerk to cancel the registration of an elector if the elector registers to vote in another county, surrenders the elector's driver license upon being issued a license in another state or is excused from jury duty for not being a United States citizen.
headline: HB 2443 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2443 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2443 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
